text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Phew. ...Hehe, how was that? 
Did I fulfill my role well?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally. Like, you were downright perfect.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Changing backstage wouldn't have left 
enough time, so you went with on stage? 
Doing magic and all on the fly like 
that... pulled off out of nowhere, it's 
seriously awesome.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Even I wasn't entirely sure I 
could pull it off, 
but taking on that challenge is what makes 
it worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Even I, with all my stage 
experience, feel anxious at times. 
So, you're going to be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wha—hey, what's with the sudden approach!? 
Too close, you're way too close!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't try to hide it. 
After all, you're trembling.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~... Ahaha, I guess so? ...I mean, 
I'm up for the grand finale, right? Kind 
of expected, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. There's no need to fret over that. 
Just give it everything you've worked for.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the same for me. Becoming a true 
entertainer— 
aiming solely for that is what brought me 
this far today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to everyone. Everyone 
covered for one another, 
leaving me no room to go meddling in their 
business.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely why I could focus on 
honing myself. 
To reach greater heights. To become a more 
captivating "Fuji Kiseki"—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watch closely. Thanks to all of you, this 
time— 
you'll see just what kind of "me" I can 
show the world.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Wha... animals!? All of those by 
herself... Ah!? 
Wait, are those holograms...!? Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Her pantomime is way too good!!! It's like 
there's a real lion right there on the 
stage...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... smiles. Smiles everywhere. From up 
here, 
I can see them so clearly. Everyone's 
surprise and delight.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm still not perfect. The ideal I 
must reach as an entertainer 
is still far ahead. Way, way down this 
path.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, let's rejoice today. 
With all our hearts. To the absolute 
fullest! Because—)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ————Aha. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(I took another step toward becoming 
everyone's "Miracle.")

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Haah. 
What is she even, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: She's so damn cool.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(I think... I get it now. 
Why she's chasing after Fuji-san.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
(Cool people keep challenging themselves, 
don't they? To reach the place they're 
aiming for, the place they want to be.)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's why her back, too—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............Alright! 
I'm gonna do it! I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if I'm the finale. 
I'm gonna show them. A version of me that 
doesn't run away!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Eh... what? A blackout? 
It went totally dark... Did something 
happen...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad...! The backup generator 
broke down, 
and we don't have enough power supply...

text_block_list.name: Stagehand
text_block_list.text:
We're drawing external power, so the air 
conditioning and basic systems are fine, 
but... the lighting. Looks like the stage 
lights are completely dead.

text_block_list.name: Stagehand
text_block_list.text:
For now, we can explain the situation with 
the lights to the audience, but... what do 
we do? The final act relies heavily on 
projection mapping, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is correct... It's an act set in the 
tranquil deep sea where a single ray of 
light shines through, with all performers 
showcasing their routines together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We could illuminate the stage with 
flashlights and force our way through... 
but both the staging and safety would fall 
short. Without our equipment, we cannot 
reach our goal.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Still. Giving up now 
would be a total joke, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even shown everything I've got. 
I don't wanna end this without doing what 
we worked so hard for!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We still have 5 minutes and 13 
seconds until the final act begins— 
let us think. That is the best course of 
action available to us right now.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
............Aha. Ahahahaha☆ 
Marvelooous!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...??? 
Is something the matter, Marvelous-san?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Look! Out in the audience! 
Stars! So many stars are shining 
bright!☆★☆
